content.title: Southern California Edison Launches Wildfire Fund
content.summary: While state and local fire officials have not confirmed the cause of the blaze, SCE says it is “likely” that its equipment could be found to be associated with the ignition.  Pedro Pizarro, CEO of Edison International, the parent company of SCE, said in an interview that the company is investigating in tandem with plaintiffs' attorneys and others.  “That hopefully is providing full transparency and confidence that we're doing this the right way and not doing something that could inadvertently damage evidence or something like that," Pizarro said.

content.title: Edison Intl (EIX) Q3 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
content.summary: Today, Edison International reported third quarter core earnings per share of $2.34 compared to $1.51 a year ago.  This comparison is not meaningful because during the quarter, SCE recorded a true-up for the 2025 general rate case final decision, which is retroactive to January 1.  Reflecting the year-to-date performance and our outlook for the remainder of the year, including the costs for potential early refinancing activities later this year, we are narrowing our 2025 core EPS guidance range to $5.95 to $6.20 and are reaffirming our 5% to 7% core EPS growth target.
